channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Pan Borneo Sabah phases expected to be completed in 2027, 2028
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The Works Ministry expects Phases 1A and 1B of the Pan Borneo Highway project in Sabah to be completed around next year and 2028 separately.

item.title: Financial planning firm Whitman makes its debut on LEAP Market
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Financial planning and retirement advisory firm Whitman Holdings Bhd debuted on the LEAP Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Bhd today, with the company saying it intends to play a constructive role in addressing Malaysia’s structural retirement planning gap.

item.title: Mat Sabu: RM7.8m allocated to tackle fishing zone encroachment
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The government is treating encroachment disputes between fishermen from Melaka and Negeri Sembilan seriously, saying the issue involves not only legal compliance but also marine sustainability and community harmony.

item.title: #SHOWBIZ: Min Hee-jin offers to forfeit RM69.5mil court award to end HYBE legal feud
item.description: SEOUL: Former ADOR chief executive Min Hee-jin said she is prepared to give up the 25.6 billion won (about RM69.5 million) she is due to receive from a recent court victory in exchange for ending all legal disputes involving HYBE.

item.title: FM Global Logistics Q2 net profit rises 3pct despite lower revenue
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: FM Global Logistics Holdings Bhd’s net profit rose 2.95 per cent to RM9.07 million for the second quarter ended Dec 31, 2025, from RM8.81 million a year earlier, supported by stronger performance in its sea freight and warehouse segments.

item.title: 20-year-old slapped with RM11k fine over traffic violations in Tawau
item.description: TAWAU: A 20-year-old woman was fined RM11,000 by the Tawau Magistrate’s Court today over four traffic offences, including driving without a valid licence.

item.title: Thai runner-up party seeks criminal case against election officials
item.description: BANGKOK: A Thai political party that came second in this month’s vote filed a criminal complaint Thursday against the nation’s election commissioners, accusing them of violating election laws, the party’s deputy told AFP.

item.title: Company director fined RM30,000 for false statement to SSM
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: A company director has been fined RM30,000 by the Johor Baru Sessions Court after pleading guilty to making a false statement to the Companies Commission of Malaysia (SSM).

item.title: Knife wielding teen who terrorised single mum, killed man jailed 31 years
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: What began as an ordinary morning turned into a waking nightmare for a single mother when she opened her eyes to find a man straddling her, a knife pressed against her neck.

item.title: Opposition urges government to halt two Bills over constitutional concerns
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: The opposition called on the government to withdraw two Bills from proceeding to their second reading in the Dewan Rakyat, citing constitutional and governance concerns.
